svg.text: Legend: blue gene/CDS span; orange transcript/promoter span; kinked arrow marks transcription start site and strand direction; black baseline is local DNA
GC strip: green-to-brown band below/above the axis summarizes local GC content in fixed bins.
Restriction sites: vertical ticks cross the axis; labels name the enzymes passing the current display filter.
Variants: orange baseline lollipops mark sequence variants in the current view.
Provenance: sequence vkorc1_rs9923231_context; local view 2114..3501 (1388 bp of 6001 bp).
